g.text: An agent's first payment to an unknown recipient asks; the owner's answer sets the rule
recipient: unknown → always | ask | deny; payment: Idle → Waiting → Queued | Refused | NotPaid (C3, C8, C9, C10, C11)
No Deny, no Always for (Mara, wallet, 0x9f3c…): rule unknown,
the wallet's default for unknown recipients is Ask.
Fits the available balance; limits hold (one open ask per
(wallet, agent, recipient, amount, asset), at most 5 per agent).
Opens a Wait (the draft) with a 24 h deadline; reserves 2 USDC.
row: payment Idle · call [... eff == 'ask' and fits] → Waiting
- Always permission {agent Mara, account, chain, to: 0x9f3c…}, scope always, no amount
- recipient label "Ana" (the identity is unchanged; a label never matches, C18)
- every other open ask it covers is answered in the same commit (answerCovered)
[the same card answered again on the phone]
then as in seq-03: sign, broadcast stored bytes, follow to Confirmed
Later: the next payment to Ana
row: Idle · call [... eff == 'always' and fits] → Queued
recipient unknown · card_pay → ask (named, rule Ask); payment Waiting · card_pay → Queued
recipient unknown · card_dont_pay → ask; payment Waiting · card_dont_pay → Refused
recipient · card_never → deny; payment Waiting · card_never [payer == 'agent'] → Refused (see seq-05)
payment Waiting · deadline → NotPaid: "Not paid: no answer" (C10)
